name: Almost Heaven Auburn 2-3 Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Auburn 2-3 Person Indoor Sauna The Almost Heaven Auburn Sauna achieves a compact, space-friendly shape while boasting a spacious feel thanks to an abundance of windows. You and two others can enjoy the sauna heat—either from the top bench, where heat rises, or a step below on the bottom bench. With the 6 kW electric Harvia KIP heater, the indoor sauna heats up to 180ºF in less than an hour. If you’d rather exercise, clean, or go about your day first, delay the start time up to eight hours. Every sauna session will be full of natural light and soothing löyly, courtesy of the Almost Heaven Auburn 3-Person Steam Sauna. Features Tongue-and-groove lumber sections: 1-3/8” finished thickness Pre-assembled wall and roof sections Utilizes the existing floor, suitable options include concrete, ceramic, vinyl, laminate, or tile flooring (carpet not recommended) Tempered glass door Stainless steel hinges, heater, and fasteners Interior LED light One full-length bench and one shorter bench Multi-level seating Indoor usage Hand-crafted construction Easy assembly for two people Best-in-class heater and sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Made in the USA Specifications Holds two to three people Heater size: 6 kW, 240V, 30-amp requirement, hard-wire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Exterior dimensions: 70″W x 47″D x 78″H Interior dimensions: 65″W x 42″D x 77″H Upper bench size: 65″L x 22″ W x 36″H Lower bench L extension size: 20″L x 15″W x 22″H Door size: 64″H x 24″W Window size: 64″H x 9″W Shipping size: 74″L x 40″W x 40″H Assembled weight: 515 Shipping weight: 700 lbs. Options and Customizations Lumber type: Choose between two different types of solid lumber. Hemfir is light in color, with small knots creating a unique pattern on each piece. Rustic cedar has a slightly red hue amongst the knots and boasts a pleasant cedar aroma. All two lumber options are 1 ⅜” thick to insulate the sauna room. Door style: Outfit your 3-person Almost Heaven Sauna with one of the following deluxe door options: full glass door, wood door with a window, or all-wood door. Heater: You can upgrade to add the luxury and ease of WiFi controls with the Harvia KIP60W with a Xenio WiFi Control Panel, or go a step further with a HUUM or Saunum heater! Shipping and Assembly The Auburn will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the 3-person indoor sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Care and Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Read more about long-term care and maintenance here. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a great sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. This sauna is perfect for those seeking a compact yet spacious feel, with multi-level seating and an abundance of light.
